(04) How we work

From attention to clients.

Every engagement runs the same four steps. You see the pipeline fill in your report every week.

  1. 01

    AuditWeek 1

    Full diagnostic — SEO health, AI crawlability, entity presence and answer potential.

  2. 02

    LaunchWeek 2–3

    Technical SEO, entity engineering, store setup or automation build.

  3. 03

    OptimiseMonth 2

    Track rankings, AI citations and answer placement weekly.

  4. 04

    ScaleMonth 3+

    Scale what works and cut what doesn't.
